name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Dated work against the calendar: a sticky label column, status-coloured bars from start to end, milestone diamonds, a today line, Month and Quarter zoom, rows without dates under No dates, and a vertical list grouped by month under 40rem.

meta.whenToUse: A list of dated work laid out against the calendar: a space's initiatives, a roadmap, a release plan.
meta.whenNotToUse: A step-by-step run log (RunTimeline), an activity history (ActivityFeed), or one date range (DatePicker).
